params.body:
Third step for `app`, after abovebeyond-ai/elixir#171 and #266. A round over the fleet this afternoon wrote verdicts on every measured `app` row (ten projects), so the PHP rule next to each line goes.

- A line takes the word Elixir gave its facet. A facet Elixir did not judge (an old row, a v1 app that sends no disk figure) is `background`, never `ok`.
- The wording that used a number reads the threshold that fired instead: "beating" is `SCHEDULER_RUNNING`, the disk figure in the summary appears when Elixir's disk verdict is above background.
- The release boundary is Elixir's fact `errorsSinceRelease`; the card reads it for "nothing since the release" and for hiding the old headlines.
- Numbers left in `RuntimeCards::app()`: none. The state-word mapping for the Judged line and the wording are all that remain.

Tests updated: the two fixtures that leaned on the rule now carry verdicts; three cases pin background-not-ok and the fact-driven release boundary. Suite green except the worktree-only `BuildStampTest`; PHPStan and Pint clean.
params.title: The App health card holds no number of its own
